nodes.label: Auditorium room at La Nube Polo Tecnológico — theater-style seating with white plastic chairs arranged in rows facing a large LED display showing the La Nube Polo Tecnológico logo; exposed concrete ceiling with recessed lighting, brick accent wall with windows on the left, white walls, barn-style sliding wooden door on the right, two wall-mounted air conditioning units, and a small side table. The space is designed for presentations, workshops, events, and talks with capacity for approximately 30–40 attendees.
